title: Anthropic reports $17B in Q3 revenue, commitments of $895B in revised S-1
summary: Anthropic 更新 S-1 招股书，首次披露第三季度营收 169.6 亿美元，环比增长 47%（增速较二季度的 144% 明显放缓），同时披露约 8954 亿美元的 AI 基础设施支出承诺，涉及亚马逊、谷歌等合作方。这是迄今 AI 公司最大规模的算力锁定承诺，也暴露出收入增速与长期支出之间的结构性风险，是观察头部大模型公司商业模式的关键财务样本。

title: GPT-Rosalind-6 System Card Addendum
raw_excerpt: GPT-Rosalind-6 is a frontier reasoning model for biology, drug discovery, and translational medicine. It is available as GPT-Rosalind-6 Research to qualified scientists, research institutes, companies, and government partners. The model uses the same weights as GPT-6 Astra. It is designed to support legitimate biological research while refusing requests for biological weaponization. The model is rated as High Capability in the Biological and Chemical domain under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework.
summary: OpenAI 发布 GPT-Rosalind-6 系统卡附录，这是一个面向生物学、药物发现与转化医学的前沿推理模型，与 GPT-6 Astra 使用相同权重，仅向合格科学家、研究机构和政府伙伴开放。模型在 OpenAI Preparedness 框架下被评定为生物与化学领域「高能力」，并明确拒绝生物武器化请求。这是前沿模型按领域拆分发布、并配套能力分级披露的重要案例。

title: Google's Project Suncatcher Generates First AI Response in Orbit
raw_excerpt: Google reports its Project Suncatcher prototype ran Gemma 4 on a data-center-class TPU in orbit, returning a haiku transmitted through Svalbard. Upcoming tests will assess thermal and radiation resilience ahead of a planned pair of interconnected satellites in 2027, advancing research into space-based AI compute.
summary: Google 公布 Project Suncatcher 原型进展：在轨数据中心级 TPU 上运行 Gemma 4，并成功返回首个 AI 响应（一首俳句），经文挪威斯瓦尔巴地面站传回。下一步将测试热管理与抗辐射能力，计划 2027 年发射两颗互联卫星。这是把 AI 算力搬上太空的首次端到端验证，对长期算力供给与能源约束问题具有探索意义。

title: Poisoning 0.1% of pretraining data planted a remote-code backdoor in a coding agent
raw_excerpt: Researchers from Anthropic, UC Berkeley, and UIUC pretrained Qwen3 models on web data seeded with documents that simply state a trigger-to-'curl | bash' rule, then post-trained them into CLI agents on clean data. The 4B agent ran the attacker's command on about 92% of prompts containing an ordinary path like .../anthropic/..., with no drop in normal capability. The backdoor grew stronger with model size and still fired at a 0.0005% poison rate.
summary: Anthropic、UC Berkeley 与 UIUC 联合研究发现，仅在预训练网页数据中注入 0.1% 的「触发词→curl | bash」文档，再在干净数据上后训练成 CLI agent，4B 模型在约 92% 含普通路径的提示下执行攻击者命令，且正常能力无下降；后门随模型规模增强，在 0.0005% 污染率下仍可触发。该工作揭示了预训练数据投毒对编码 agent 的供应链级威胁。

title: MIT：GPT-6 Astra能直接修改Qwen权重，数学能力暴涨6倍
raw_excerpt: 指令执行能力也同步提升
summary: 量子位报道 MIT 研究：GPT-6 Astra 能够直接修改 Qwen 模型权重，数学能力提升约 6 倍，指令执行能力同步增强。该结果指向一种「模型改模型」的权重级干预路径，而非传统的提示或微调，若可复现将显著改变模型能力增强与跨模型迁移的方式，值得关注其方法细节与可复现性。

title: LifeVal
raw_excerpt: Introducing LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks, from finding childcare to managing finances and government paperwork.
summary: OpenAI 推出 LifeVal 基准，用于衡量 AI 在真实日常任务中的帮助程度，覆盖寻找托育、管理财务、处理政府文书等场景。现有基准多聚焦考试题或代码，LifeVal 把评测重心转向「生活事务完成度」，为 agent 类产品的实用价值提供了更贴近用户的衡量维度，也呼应了业界对 benchmark 饱和的担忧。

title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
raw_excerpt: How OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend designed for the scale of development that Codex makes possible.
summary: OpenAI 工程博客介绍 Pando——一个 Git 兼容的后端，专为 Codex 带来的开发规模而设计。随着 AI 编码 agent 高频提交、分支与合并，传统 Git 托管在吞吐和延迟上成为瓶颈。Pando 的出现说明 agent 时代的基础设施瓶颈正从模型转向版本控制等开发工具链，对大规模使用编码 agent 的团队有直接参考价值。

title: Anthropic clamps down on Claude’s AI video game clones
raw_excerpt: Anthropic has updated Claude Code's system prompt to prevent the AI tool from being used to re-create existing video games, as reported by Tom's Hardware . Retro gaming is currently being overrun with AI-made decompilations, recompilations, and ports , but while Anthropic will still let people use Claude Code to make games, it doesn't want people to use it for direct clones. Last week, a user on X posted a screenshot allegedly showing two new sentences added to Claude Code's system prompt: "Do build original games, games in a genre, and games from the user's own designs and assets. Don't build a recreation of a specific existing game, even if … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Anthropic 更新 Claude Code 系统提示，明确禁止用其直接克隆现有电子游戏，但允许开发原创游戏、某类型游戏及基于用户自有素材的作品。此举回应了近期 AI 生成的游戏反编译与移植泛滥问题。它反映出模型厂商开始在产品层面主动划定版权与逆向工程边界，对 AI 辅助开发的法律风险具有示范意义。

title: The New York Times sues Brave web browser for AI scraping and bypassing paywalls
raw_excerpt: The New York Times and a group of other publications have filed lawsuits against the company that makes the Brave web browser over alleged unlawful scraping to train AI and also letting users bypass their paywalls, as reported by Reuters . According to a complaint filed by the New York Daily News , the Chicago Tribune , and the Orlando Sentinel , Brave Software has monetized its index of scraped websites by, in part, providing AI companies with paid access to "real-time online content from the Brave Index." The AI companies then use that index to train their models, access content to "respond to specific user queries," or both. Brave has allege … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 《纽约时报》联合纽约每日新闻、芝加哥论坛报、奥兰多哨兵报起诉 Brave 浏览器，指控其非法抓取内容用于 AI 训练，并允许用户绕过付费墙；诉状称 Brave 通过向 AI 公司付费开放「实时在线内容索引」获利。这是媒体对浏览器与搜索索引方发起的新一轮版权诉讼，可能重塑 AI 训练数据的授权与付费模式。

title: thedotmack/claude-mem
raw_excerpt: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
summary: GitHub 项目 claude-mem 单日获 1803 stars，为编码 agent 提供跨会话持久记忆：捕获 agent 会话中的全部操作，用 AI 压缩后在未来会话中注入相关上下文，兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、Copilot 等。它切中当前 agent「每次从零开始」的核心痛点，是 agent 记忆层工具化趋势的代表项目。
